_comment: Yeh file Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 ke mandatory declarations ko 'rules' ke roop mein define karti hai. Naya rule add karna ho toh bas neeche ek naya object add kar do - code change nahi karna padega. 'regex' field ek strict/fast pehla-attempt match hai (jab OCR clean ho). 'value_regex' field un cases ke liye hai jab OCR ne keyword ke ird-gird kuch noise/typo daal diya ho (jaise 'MRP' ko 'MRPs' padh liya) - engine pehle keyword ko FUZZY match se dhoondta hai (chhoti spelling mistakes allow karte hue), phir uske aas-paas 'value_regex' se asli value nikalta hai. Yeh approach OCR-noise-tolerant hai (dekho rules_engine/engine.py ke comments mein iske peeche ki research).

rules.label: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Name & Address
rules.description: Label par manufacturer ya packer ya importer ka naam aur poora address hona chahiye.

rules.label: Net Quantity
rules.description: Product ki net quantity standard unit (g, kg, ml, l, ya count) mein clearly likhi honi chahiye.

rules.label: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
rules.description: MRP 'inclusive of all taxes' ke saath currency symbol (Rs./₹) mein likhi honi chahiye.
rules._note: regex mein 'mbp'/'mnp'/'mrrp' bhi shamil hain kyunki OCR aksar 'MRP' ko in tarah galat padhta hai (R/B jaise letters kai fonts mein ek jaisi dikhte hain) - 'mrp' khud itna chhota keyword hai ki fuzzy-matching safety-filter (MIN_KEYWORD_LENGTH_FOR_FUZZY) use skip kar deta, isliye known confusions ko seedha regex mein daala hai.

rules.label: Month & Year of Manufacture/Packing/Import
rules.description: Manufacturing ya packing ya import ka month aur year clearly likha hona chahiye (MM/YYYY ya Month YYYY format mein).

rules.label: Consumer Care Details
rules.description: Consumer care ka phone number ya email address label par hona chahiye taaki customer complaint kar sake.

rules.label: Country of Origin
rules.description: Agar product imported hai toh country of origin batana mandatory hai.
rules._note: Yeh rule khud toh optional hai (sab products ke liye mandatory nahi), LEKIN agar label pe 'imported by' mila (matlab yeh ek imported product hai), toh Country of Origin declare karna Legal Metrology Rules ke hisaab se mandatory ho jaata hai - engine.py isko dynamically upgrade karta hai (category-aware rule, static 'required: false' nahi rehta).

rules.label: Minimum Font Size / Readability
rules.description: Declarations ka font size legal minimum se chota nahi hona chahiye taaki normal vision wala consumer bina magnifying glass ke padh sake. NOTE: Bina physical reference scale (jaise ek known-size object image mein) ke, pixel se real-world mm nikalna approximate hi hota hai - yeh ek heuristic check hai, legal proof nahi.
rules._note: required:false rakha hai jaan-boojh kar - yeh check photo ke distance/framing par bahut depend karta hai (poora product photo vs sirf label ka close-up), aur khud description mein likha hai ki yeh sirf heuristic hai, legal proof nahi. Isko hard 'required' banane se normal camera photos (jisme poora product photograph hota hai, sirf text zoom nahi) galat FAIL de sakti thi.
